notes.title: Early Access Update + 1899: Secrets of the Maze Released!
notes.content:
The full release of Escape Zombie Maze has been delayed due to ongoing development of the stealth animation system and new AI behaviors.

We're currently facing integration issues with the new systems, and some modules need to be rewritten from scratch, which naturally requires additional time. However, the game continues to move forward steadily.
🧠 Development Status and Technical Details:

    Stealth animations are currently incompatible with the existing system.

    AI and control systems are being rebuilt from scratch to support these new features.

    As a result, the early access period has been extended.

    A new official trailer will be released once the game nears completion.

🧩 New Game Released – 1899: Secrets of the Maze

Our brand-new title, 1899: Secrets of the Maze, which expands the Escape Zombie Maze universe, is now available!

This game tells the story from a different time period and with a new protagonist.
It also includes two chapters directly from Escape Zombie Maze, offering fans a connected experience with a fresh twist.

If you're into horror, mystery, and puzzle-solving, you'll definitely want to check it out.
💰 Pricing and Purchase Information:

    Once Escape Zombie Maze is completed, its price will be increased.

    However, players who purchase the current early access version will not be affected by the price change.

    If, for any reason, the project is discontinued, the current price will remain unchanged.

🙏 Thank You and Final Note:

Thank you to everyone supporting both games!
Please feel free to share your feedback, suggestions, and thoughts — your input is incredibly valuable.

This project grows stronger with your support!

notes.title: Escape: Zombie Maze - A New Update is Coming!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We are preparing a major update for Escape: Zombie Maze. Here’s what you can expect:

    The Last 10 Levels: The final 10 levels of the game are being added. These levels will require more strategy and offer greater challenges!

    Katana Update: The katana will be improved. As there will be no ammunition available in the last 10 levels, this weapon will be crucial for your survival.

    Background Music: Background music will be added to the first 17 levels. Additionally, dark-themed levels will feature appropriate atmospheric music.

    Zombie Combat: The game remains realistic – defeating zombies without precise strikes is tough. However, this update may introduce adjustments to combat mechanics, especially in the early levels.

    Traps: Traps will be introduced in the last 10 levels. You’ll need to lure zombies into these traps – a new strategic challenge!

    Labyrinth Improvements: Due to the large size of the labyrinths, small hints like lights, images, or holograms will be added from level 24 onwards to assist with navigation.

Remember: This update will make the game more strategic and deliver an even more intense zombie combat experience. Get ready for new content and improvements!

We’ll share more details about this update soon. Stay tuned, and thank you for your support!

notes.title: Escape Zombie Maze 0.5.2 Update – Bug Fixes and New Features
notes.content:
Hello survivors!

The Escape Zombie Maze 0.5.2 update brings several important fixes and new features:

    Level 12: Fixed the issue where the game would freeze when jumping into voids.
    Slow Motion: Added slow motion to the first 6 levels.
    UI Updates: Information about melee attacks using the 'F' key and weapon selection is now displayed on the UI.
    Portal Text: Added a message indicating that you don’t need to kill zombies when you see the 'Portal On' text.

These updates aim to improve your gameplay experience. Don’t forget to share your feedback, and happy gaming!

notes.title: Escape Zombie Maze 0.4.9.2 Update – Bug Fixes and New Developments
notes.content:
Hello survivors!

The Escape Zombie Maze 0.4.9.2 update brings several important fixes and developments:

    Bug Fixes: Resolved issues with ammunition collection in Levels 12, 13, and 14, and fixed problems with achievement unlocking.
    Code Updates: Updated codes for smoother gameplay.
    New Levels: Additional levels will be added sequentially. Shotgun levels will now include ammunition collection.
    New Mazes and Corridor: New maze levels are being developed, with a potential shotgun-focused maze and a corridor section in the works.
    Story Elements: The story provides subtle clues, with maze levels designed as intended. Interlude levels aim to convey specific messages—players will decide if these are effective.
    Architecture and Design: Visual and architectural choices are crafted to communicate meaningful messages to players.
    Metro Section: Temporarily removed due to AI issues; it may return if an alternative solution is found.

Thank you for your feedback and support! Enjoy the updates and stay tuned for more.
